results.title: Biozentrum Research Summer (University of Basel)
results.eligibility_notes: Verified: open to Bachelor students in Biology/related sciences; requires Swiss or EU citizenship (persona is EU citizen). Suited to students at end of 2nd year. No prior research experience required.
results.notes: 7-9 weeks (mid-Jul-mid-Sep); stipend CHF 1,736/month gross; 2026 window was Jan 2-Feb 25; 2027 dates not yet posted (expected similar). Working language English.

results.title: Max Planck School Matter to Life - Undergraduate Research Opportunity (URO)
results.organization: Max Planck School Matter to Life
results.eligibility_notes: Verified: Bachelor students in MtL-related fields, must stay enrolled before & during placement, GPA >=1.7 (German scale). Persona is biology Bachelor but GPA not in profile -> cannot confirm GPA bar. Apply 1 Aug-1 Oct 2026 for a 2027 internship (Jun-Nov).
results.notes: 10-week fully funded (travel, accommodation, living); choose host lab.

results.title: HU Berlin Humboldt Internship Program - CropScience Research
results.organization: Humboldt-Universitaet zu Berlin, Faculty of Life Science
results.eligibility_notes: Verified: 'Advanced undergraduate students (from second year)' and Master's students; English working language (German a plus). Persona is year 2 -> meets. 2027 application period opens November 2026 (2026 closed).
results.notes: On-site; lab + field/greenhouse work; ecology/climate-change angle fits interests.

results.title: Erasmus+ Traineeship Abroad
results.eligibility_notes: Verified: open to any student at an institution holding the Erasmus Charter; traineeship 2-12 months; EU citizen enrolled in a German university qualifies. Funding arranged via home university's international office.
results.notes: Good vehicle for a biology lab placement abroad; combine with specific host offers (e.g., Slovenian Forestry Institute wood-anatomy).

results.title: Deutschlandstipendium (Germany Scholarship)
results.organization: German Federal Ministry of Education & Research / participating universities
results.eligibility_notes: Verified: open to all nationalities enrolled in a degree program at a participating German university (EU citizens eligible); Bachelor & Master students; needs above-average grades + at least one extra criterion (social/ecological engagement, etc.). Persona must apply at their own university; exact deadline varies by institution (~Dec 2026 for 2027/28).
results.notes: EUR 300/month; no nationality bar; found via German-language funding query.

results.title: EPFL School of Life Sciences International Summer Research Program
results.eligibility_notes: Bachelor students after >=2 years; biology/bioinformatics among fields. Persona year 2 (completing 2nd year by summer) likely meets. High GPA expected. 2027 deadline expected ~Nov 2026 (2026 was Nov 15).
results.notes: 8 weeks, stipend ~CHF 3,600; official page not fetched this run.

results.title: EASL Congress 2027 (abstract submission / student attendance)
results.organization: European Association for the Study of the Liver
results.eligibility_notes: Open abstract submission & registration; undergraduates with a research project could present a poster, but the congress is primarily for professionals/scientists. Attendance as a student is possible.
results.notes: 16-19 Jun 2027; abstract deadline 19 Jan 2027, early fee 25 Jan 2027. Life-science event in Europe.

results.title: HiWi / Werkstudent - Student Research Assistant positions (Germany)
results.eligibility_notes: EU/EEA students face no weekly work limit in Germany; biology undergraduates can assist in labs (sample prep, data analysis, field work). No single official page - found via guide; apply through department job boards / direct professor contact.
results.notes: Explore-layer: ongoing, local, builds lab experience & LORs; complements summer internships.

excluded.title: DAAD RISE Germany
excluded.reason: Hard-constraint conflict: program is for undergraduates enrolled at universities in North America, the UK and Ireland. Persona is enrolled at a German (EU) university -> Ineligible (verified on daad.de).

run_notes: Locale script resolved mode A / regions=remote / primary=en, but profile preferred_country=[Germany,Netherlands] and school_country=Germany were applied per SKILL Step 3, so de locale was loaded and DE/NL/EU searched in en+de. Covered 6 categories incl. funding (Deutschlandstipendium via de query) and an explore item (HiWi).
